nodes.label: 3000-instance USD benchmark
nodes.description: 3,000 native instances in 20 property groups colored without notices; scan 0.17 seconds, override update 1.28 seconds versus prior 8.41 seconds. Measurements exclude RTX frame rate.

nodes.label: BS17 production-scene regression
nodes.description: An isolated BS17 check found 1,458 final Xforms and colored 1,391; 67 lacked loaded renderable geometry. RTX red pixels were 0 before, 285,953 during, and 0 after Disable. Root layer and source file hash remained unchanged.

nodes.label: Final editable Xforms
nodes.description: An object is an editable Xform without descendant Xforms. Native instance roots count once. Child meshes, subsets, standalone meshes, spatial IFC containers, instance proxies, and visible internal reference sources are excluded.

nodes.label: Unverified runtime boundaries
nodes.description: As documented on 2026-09-22, the existing Composer still needed the updated extension reloaded and background restoration had not been visually verified there. Streaming, concurrent viewers, browser transfer, and exact Forma parity were untested.

nodes.label: Stable per-criterion palette
nodes.description: Assignments persist per criterion through refreshes, property switches, and absent values; new assignments use stable hashing over a fixed 40-color palette.

nodes.label: Native Composer color panel
nodes.description: Automatically opens when enabled; provides grouping modes, searchable properties, Enable colors, legend swatches, No color, Refresh, and notices.

nodes.label: Implementation review
nodes.description: Independent standards and specification reviews against baseline a382c2f reported zero remaining findings after fixes.

nodes.label: Property File and Model grouping
nodes.description: One whole-stage criterion is active. Property uses authored scalar custom attributes; File uses the defining resolved USD layer; Model uses nearest ancestor metadata or asset identity, never prim names.

nodes.label: Inherited Xform properties
nodes.description: Read properties from the target Xform and Xform ancestors, with nearest values taking precedence; ignore mesh metadata.

nodes.label: Manual loaded-stage refresh
nodes.description: Scan loaded, active, defined prims on manual refresh; do not load payloads or continuously update during animation.

nodes.label: Agreed Object Colors scope
nodes.description: Scope derived from the user handoff on 2026-09-21, the design interview, and 2026-09-22 updates requiring final-Xform solid colors and removal of shared-template controls.

nodes.label: SOL10 environment exclusion regression
nodes.description: The initial live panel counted 18,111 Xforms including Environment, allowing color to inherit to Sky. After exclusion, a read-only scan finds 18,110 model Xforms and no targeted ancestors of Sky or DistantLight.

nodes.label: Shared template controls removed
nodes.description: The user requested removal of shared templates, template loading, and JSON import/export controls while retaining scene persistence.

nodes.label: Scheme undo and redo
nodes.description: Undo and redo cover mode, property, enabled state, and palette changes.

nodes.label: Scene color state persistence
nodes.description: User edits write JSON to root customLayerData.objectColorsState. Normal scene save persists it; reopening rebuilds the temporary rendering layer. Read-only roots can color but cannot retain state.

nodes.label: Typed value groups
nodes.description: Values preserve scalar types. First 100 typed values in deterministic order are shown; excess values form Unmapped. Missing values form Unassigned separately from the literal string.

nodes.label: Object Colors for USD Composer
nodes.description: Windows Kit 110.2 extension that colors a whole USD stage by property, source file, or model and saves the active scheme with the scene.

nodes.label: Isolated Kit rendering workflow
nodes.description: run-verify-kit.ps1 loads the tested checkout in an isolated Kit app, renders generated native instances and environment lighting, measures pixels, and checks editing, undo, persistence, stage replacement, and shutdown.

nodes.label: Focused USD verification
nodes.description: run-verify.ps1 runs 23 focused unittest cases against installed USD libraries, covering grouping, discovery, persistence, exclusion, bindings, cleanup, and restoration.

nodes.label: Anonymous session color layer
nodes.rationale: Keep temporary materials and bindings in a dedicated anonymous session sublayer to preserve source materials and geometry. Disable mutes it; No color omits overrides; shutdown removes it.

nodes.label: Solid Xform material bindings
nodes.rationale: Direct opaque USD Preview Surface bindings on final Xforms support RTX native instances. Expanding collections handle ancestor priorities across material purposes; children, glass, and subsets inherit solid color.

nodes.label: Kit Python static typecheck
nodes.rationale: run-typecheck.ps1 uses mypy with check_untyped_defs, but incomplete Kit and USD type stubs mean runtime verification remains necessary.

nodes.label: Light and camera exclusion
nodes.rationale: Exclude Xforms containing lights or cameras, including mixed geometry rigs and native instance prototypes, so the overlay cannot replace sky or environment materials.

nodes.label: HOOPS-qualified property labels
nodes.rationale: Retain HOOPS source context in display labels so removing a namespace cannot make different properties indistinguishable.

nodes.label: Legitimate reserved-name geometry
nodes.rationale: Remove the broad reserved-name filter because it skipped legitimate user geometry.

nodes.label: Stale palette callback guard
nodes.rationale: Validate captured criterion and stage generation and hide the palette on panel rebuild, preventing an old group key from changing a new criterion or stage.

nodes.label: Batched Composer work
nodes.rationale: Batch long work so Composer continues processing frames.

nodes.label: RTX collection-only binding regression
nodes.rationale: Collection-only overrides resolved in USD but did not render on native-instance descendants in RTX. Direct opaque bindings to each Xform plus expanding collections fixed the rendered failure and removed source-opacity rejection.

nodes.label: Search SVG icon
nodes.description: SVG asset with a 24×24 viewBox, an unfilled circle, and a diagonal path, both stroked in #b8b8b8. Its filename and geometry suggest a magnifying-glass search icon.
nodes.limitation: Inspected SVG source only; visual rendering was unavailable because the checked Python environment lacked rasterization libraries.
